title: New York sues Kalshi for alleged violations of its gambling laws; the CFTC files an emergency motion to stop the state's enforcement, calling it an "overreach" (Jonathan Stempel/Reuters)
summary: Jonathan Stempel / Reuters: New York sues Kalshi for alleged violations of its gambling laws; the CFTC files an emergency motion to stop the state's enforcement, calling it an “overreach” — New York's attorney general sued Kalshi on Friday, claiming that its prediction market platform violates state laws against illegal gambling.
